author: Discovery
description:
After delivering $1.2M worth of Northern Red King Crab, Captain Keith races to kick off his bairdi crab fishery. 

He has 48 hours, before the grounds are picked over by a 37 boat fleet. 

He also gets an unexpected call from Captain John about Freddy.
